data.narrative:
Voltra is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector founded by Alexander Stratmoen and Aryan Afrouzi. The company has raised $1.8M to date. The sector includes nine known peers spanning public and private markets, with one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

A stage-progression method was applied given the absence of sufficient same-stage comparables in the Climate & Energy universe. Using total capital raised ($1.8M, rounded to $2M) as a proxy base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $4M. This method is grounded in observed step-up dynamics but carries inherent uncertainty given early stage and limited operational track record.

The peer-median method was not applicable; while nine peers exist in Climate & Energy, none met narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparisons. Constructing medians from the broader peer set risked material misalignment with Voltra's early stage. Analysis therefore relies on a single triangulation method, implying a valuation range of $4M (low) to $5M (high), with a median point of $4M. Key uncertainties include technology validation risk, competitive positioning within a dense sector, and the typical dilution associated with early funding rounds.
